claim_title: The Streptococcus salivarius K12 (SsK12) probiotic supports the healing and defense of the throat lining
caption: **SsK12 and the throat lining.** None of the reviewed studies actually measured throat healing or mucosal defense — they tracked mouth sores and symptom-free days instead. SsK12 showed no benefit on the outcomes measured, the main trial result was negative overall, and one positive subgroup finding came from a study led by a paid company advisor. The evidence does not support the claim.
subtitle: None of the reviewed studies measured throat healing, and results were negative.
